name: doca-telemetry-utils
description: doca_telemetry_utils command line on a host with DOCA: discover the diagnostic-counter schema, translate counter names to binary Data IDs and back, and check per-device counter support before committing a DOCA Telemetry exporter config. Use this skill when telemetry counters vanish between the exporter and the collector: "my exporter ships but the collector sees nothing", "this metric silently drops downstream", "which counters does this BlueField expose", "translate this 0x... back to a counter name", "what do node / pcie_index / depth mean here", or "is this counter supported on this device", even without naming the tool. Route exporter or collector code to doca-telemetry-exporter / doca-telemetry, DTS deployment to doca-dts, and DOCA install or repair to doca-setup.
